blurb: Bella Ballerina offers dance classes for children including ballet, jazz, tap, and hip hop, with age-appropriate groupings and dress codes. They also provide themed summer and spring break camps with dance, crafts, storytime, and performances. Classes are held in short seasonal sessions of about 12 weeks, with options for year-round enrollment.
